headline: Dow (DOW) Stock Could Look Reasonable After a 43% Gain
summary: Dow has delivered a strong 43.5% return over the past year, which puts a spotlight on a simple question for holders and potential buyers alike. Are investors now paying a price that is fully backed by the cash this business is expected to generate over time, or have expectations moved ahead of the underlying stream of dollars?
